lemmas.name: ms45_nil
lemmas.statement: ∀ (xs : List Int) (h : maxSubarraySum_precond xs), xs = [] → maxSubarraySum_postcond xs (0) h
lemmas.proof:
by intro xs h hx
  unfold maxSubarraySum_postcond
  subst hx; simp

children.expr: (let subarray_sums := List.range (xs.length + 1) |>.flatMap (fun start => List.range' 1 (xs.length - start) |>.map (fun len => ((xs.drop start).take len).sum)); subarray_sums.foldl max (subarray_sums.headD 0))

lemmas.name: ms45_ne
lemmas.statement: ∀ (xs : List Int) (h : maxSubarraySum_precond xs), xs ≠ [] → maxSubarraySum_postcond xs (let subarray_sums := List.range (xs.length + 1) |>.flatMap (fun start => List.range' 1 (xs.length - start) |>.map (fun len => ((xs.drop start).take len).sum)); subarray_sums.foldl max (subarray_sums.headD 0)) h
lemmas.proof:
by intro xs h hx
  unfold maxSubarraySum_postcond
  obtain ⟨x, t, rfl⟩ := List.exists_cons_of_ne_nil hx
  exact Refine.maxlist_int_any _ (List.ne_nil_of_mem (a := ((([x] ++ t).drop 0).take 1).sum) (List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨0, List.mem_range.mpr (by simp), List.mem_map.mpr ⟨1, by simp [List.mem_range'_1], rfl⟩⟩))
